_comment: experiment_v7 — Mid-term directional: live book + tick flow AND mid-TF candles; wide TP/SL.
_comment_entry_mode: microstructure = WS only. candles = REST klines only. both = micro + candle must agree (recommended for your mix of L2/trades + higher TF).
_comment_reverse: If true, place the opposite side vs the resolved entry. HTF gate uses the executed side. CLI --reverse forces true for this run.
_comment_signal: Live WebSocket: ob_imbalance AND trade_pressure_5m (rolling 5m net buy/sell from ticks). Tighten thresholds for fewer trades; loosen slightly if too few fills vs 60m candle.
_signal_rationale: Mid-term book+flow timing on top of 60m trend: require strong micro agreement when the hourly bar agrees.
_comment_pos: Native TP/SL on exchange. 5%/5% is a starting band for multi-hour swings — tune per symbol volatility.
_tp_sl_rationale: Wider stops need longer max_hold_min. Fees are small vs 5% moves; main issue is time and path. Symmetric 5% TP/SL implies ~50% win rate before costs to break even on notional (ignoring funding).
_comment_size: Notional = equity × max_risk_pct / sl_pct, capped at max_notional_usd. With sl_pct=0.05, same max_risk_pct gives smaller $ position than with tight scalps.
_size_rationale: 0.5% account risk per trade if stop is hit (notional × sl_pct ≈ equity × max_risk_pct).
_comment_freq: Mid-frequency: longer cooldown and scan interval than scalp mode.
_comment_lev: Reduce leverage for wider stops if exchange margin is tight.
_comment_symbols: Bybit linear symbols for WebSocket + scanning. Path relative to this folder unless absolute.
_comment_htf: Extra REST kline gate on executed side. With entry_mode=both and 60m candle leg, set 0 to avoid triple-filtering the same idea; or use 240/360 for a second higher TF filter.
_comment_md_archive: Bybit does not provide ~1y of historical L2/trades on the public API. Set md_record_dir to build your own dataset (JSONL) while the bot runs. Or use env MARKET_DATA_RECORD_DIR. Watch disk on busy symbols.
_comment_research: Append-only JSONL (one JSON object per line) under this strategy folder unless path is absolute. Set research_jsonl_path to "" to disable. Events: session_start/stop, entry, entry_skip (htf_gate|qty_zero|order_failed), trade_close (join on entry_id), optional signal_snapshot if research_signal_interval_sec > 0 (adds REST in candle/both modes).
